title: Coptis unveils Purple, a “Prompt-to-Formula” AI agent for cosmetic R&D
summary: At its annual Users Club, held in Paris on October 13, 2026, software publisher Coptis, which specializes in formulation and regulatory compliance, unveiled two AI-powered innovations: Purple and Document Reader. Designed for R&D, formulation and regulatory affairs teams, the tools aim to accelerate cosmetic product development and streamline technical data management.
